tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Kisi bhi city ka current weather batata hai. City ka naam enter karein. Response mein temperature, humidity aur wind speed shamil hogi.

tools.description: Do values ka sum calculate karta hai. Pehla number 'a' aur doosra 'b' ke taur pe dein.
